notes: A supply run, and the one real judgement call is the item list. Walkthrough bullet [1] holds two journeys -- Hieronymus at (E-8), then the Quartermaster at Bastok Markets (S) (H-9) -- so it is split across steps 1 and 2, with both bullet numbers kept on each. The ten items come from the "After the walkthrough: Notes" section, whose bullets restart at [1] and whose heading in the wikitext is "Items requested by the Quartermaster"; the page never says whether all ten are wanted in one run or one is picked per run. The counts (33 Ginger Cookies, 6 Windurst Tacos, 4 Apple Pies, 3 Roast Trout) read as separate single requests rather than one bundle, and the sibling Stock and Awe IV (B) states "one of the following" outright for its list, so the ten are recorded as ALTERNATIVES with items_partial set. If that is wrong the ladder advances a little early; the AND reading, if wrong, would leave it permanently unsatisfiable. Campaign Rank is literally "???" on the page -- unknown, so nothing is asserted and no rank flag is raised. Header Level "Any" is not a level gate. gates.expansion and gates.repeatable are both null: the Campaign Header template carries neither field and no bullet states either, so nothing on this page supports asserting them.
